Targeting note:
When targeting specifically about her body, you should also add a filter for either the chubby or skinny tag, this is due to her being planned to have a skinny alt by the time sponsorship starts.

Character stuff:
Hex’s name is unknown and is planned to remain unknown as she is supposed to represent the entire trainer class. The in lore reason is she doesn’t want the game following her back to kalos and has a slight bit of paranoia about it.
Hex has a stutter, this can come and go especially if flustered or when infodumping respectively. The cause of this is an incident in training Haunter where he licked Hex. Rather than cause hex to shudder until she dies, she was left with a stutter.
Hex feels most comfortable when surrounded by the occult rather than when surrounded by normal people. Sometimes she can even use her sense of comfort to tell someone is supernatural.
Hex lives in Laverre City in Kalos along with her older sister who is a fairy tale girl.(and as such will not be in game for obvious reasons)
Occupation wise, Hex has two, the first is selling Moomoo Milk, it is not her breast milk. The second is as a consultant for ghosts and ghost type pokemon. Though she considers the second her main job, it’s more of a hobby which goes with her other hobby of exploring abandoned and theoretically haunted buildings.

Haunter
Haunter is Hex’s partner pokemon. He’s not her First Partner/starter pokemon, that would be a drifloon that ran away after she got too heavy. Haunter is mischievous but also protective. He will pull pranks, give hex privacy(while also pulling a prank by not showing up to continue taking her clothes), but will end it if anything dangerous happens to protect hex. (IE: explosions, bullets being shot everywhere.) Only to start again once the coast is clear.
Moves: Hex, Mean look, Scary Face, Curse.
Nature: Impish, Gender: Male

Gimmicks
Ghost Yapping: Hex has lines for every ghost type pokemon. This targets tags, specific characters, etc. However, if you are targeted by this you do not have to respond to the target as it’s her yapping. There is a marker that all of them have if you look, This you can use to have them react to the walls of text.
Lactation: Chubby hex lactates, Specifically when the Milky marker is said.
